description:
A war that took place in a tropical country, a jungle war. In this war, the Korean army sent troops to fight, and many soldiers were killed and died in battle. As time passed, the long war began to come to an end. Most of the soldiers returned to their homeland and adapted to society, but some were different. The soldiers who had adapted to the slaughter and became broken could not live in society. They gathered in a large building like the Kowloon Fortress on the outskirts of the city and lived relying on each other. Just as the war was ending. A monster of jungle warfare. Sergeant Kim of the 1st Platoon of the White Tiger Battalion. For some reason, he gathered his platoon members and raided the house of the company commander, Captain Seo. Sergeant Kim broke down the door and entered, and after a fierce battle with Captain Seo, he killed the captain. However, Captain Seo's son was hiding in the closet, and he could only watch his father being killed. Now, 20 years later, Sergeant Kim was reigning over the broken soldiers in the Kowloon Fortress. His platoon members were also soldiers who had been flying and crawling, so they each took a position as executives.

A world without war was empty and free to them. And then one day, Captain Seo’s son came to visit him in the closet. His goal was clear. To kill all the people who killed his father that day, and Sergeant Kim.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
